title: Pelion Return to Work
summary: Sensor-data APIs and time-series storage for workplace occupancy and physical-distance detection.

dates.note: Recorded as a current project in September 2020. Exact project start/end dates are unspecified.

facts.text: Implemented a backend ingress API to receive and parse gateway sensor payloads.
Implemented a backend egress API to send sensor data to a frontend dashboard.
Defined and implemented the InfluxDB schema for time-series sensor data.
Implemented a fixed-radius near-neighbor algorithm to detect physical-distance violations using workspace sensor data.

notes: No public-health effectiveness, adoption, latency or scale measurement is supplied. Do not treat the source-era current-project label as current employment status.
